confirmed_harness_finding.repair_reported: Accept either the matching recorded refusal, or the exact other-tab-refresh notice with a new non-null Favorites storage event. Still require the first durable record, no second saved claim, explicit retry, and both durable successes.

Both rejection and reviewed dialogs name their heading; rejection errors use alert and results/count messages use status.
Explicit scope remains authoritative, conflicting diagnoses disable save, and No Tie/no-topwear controls expose only relevant scopes/reasons.

The optional automatic-image panel exposes separate consent, disables controls while working and clears its in-memory credential on close.
